dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Acute ischemic left pontomesencephalic infarction causing an ocular tilt reaction and left internuclear ophthalmoplegia, due to top-of-the-basilar basilar artery occlusion (vertebrobasilar ischemic stroke).

Alternative: Acute demyelinating pontomesencephalic lesion, such as multiple sclerosis

Alternative: Peripheral vestibular lesion causing ocular tilt reaction

Alternative: Cerebellar or brainstem ischemia from vertebral artery dissection or cardioembolism rather than in situ basilar thrombosis
